hook.text: Jazz improvisers play unexpected notes. Pop songs repeat the same four chords. Which has more entropy?

buildup.text: Musical entropy has been measured: jazz has higher entropy than pop, classical falls in between.

discovery.text: High-entropy compositions surprise listeners more. But too much surprise becomes noise instead of music.

twist.text: The sweet spot for creativity may be moderate entropy—surprising enough to be interesting, structured enough to follow.

climax.text: Artists intuitively manage entropy. They balance predictability with surprise across every creative medium.

punchline.text: Great art: enough surprise to delight, enough pattern to follow.

quiz.question: What does high musical entropy indicate?
options: The note sequences are less predictable
